Stakeholders must define the in-scope and out-of-scope items for the project.
Scope document is reviewed and signed off by all key stakeholders.

Stakeholder register is created and approved by project manager.

sections.title: 7. Risk & Compliance Baseline
sections.body: The verified audit findings indicate no risk factors. However, the project must comply with the GENERIC_ENTERPRISE domain standards, which include SOC 2, GDPR (if applicable), and ISO 27001. The standard NFR benchmarks for this domain are P95 latency targets < 250ms, 99.9% uptime SLA, and AES-256 data encryption. These compliance frameworks and NFR benchmarks will serve as the baseline for the project's risk and compliance management.
